kashikaEnglish: A sūtra with svarita accent marks an adhikāra (governing rule) that extends over subsequent sūtras.
englishShort: In this सूत्रपाठ, a स्वरित स्वर is used to denote अनुवृत्तिs.
englishFull:
A word with स्वरित (circumflex) accent indicates an अधिकार (governing rule).

Sūtras are normally unmarked. When a sūtra has svarita accent (learned from commentaries), it governs subsequent sūtras.

**Governing sūtras:**
- प्रत्ययः (@ref[3.1.1])
- धातोः (@ref[3.1.91])
- अङ्गस्य (@ref[6.4.1])
- भस्य (@ref[6.4.129])
